meta.direction: Neo-Tactile Soft UI, matched one-to-one to reference image C:/Dev/Tempo-Design/9d607248922bb2053a1b000d3e7809c3.jpg (Kris, 2026-10-13): warm off-white page, cream and sand slabs, taupe base cards, sage action color with a mint hover glow, dusty-rose accent for sliders and the elevated card, blue only for focus and selection. Small radii (8..20), gentle lift shadows with a diffused top highlight, soft inner shadows for wells.
meta.theme-priority: Light is the product (Kris). Dark is derived and must stay legible; it is not the reference.

tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: The page. Warm off-white (reference page background). Every slab sits on it.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cream slab: dropdown menus, dialogs, toasts, the table container and header, the token panel. Raised with shadow-raise.

tokens.name: surface-sand
tokens.usage: Sand slab: the raised card and stat tiles (reference Raised Card). Raised with shadow-raise.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells: inputs, selects, the toggle off-track, the slider's empty track. Pairs with shadow-sunken.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hovered table rows and list items.

tokens.name: surface-deep
tokens.usage: The deep sunken tile (reference Empty State Tile) and pressed wells.

tokens.name: surface-overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim behind dialogs.

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: The diffused top highlight of every raised slab and the light edge of sunken wells. Never a fill.

tokens.name: shade
tokens.usage: The warm shadow color (used with alpha in every shadow token). Never a fill.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Titles and body text on canvas, surface, surface-sand, surface-sunken (12:1).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: captions, helper text, table headers, meta lines (5.3:1 on surface-sand).

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Placeholders, disabled text, tick marks. 24px+ text or decorative only.

tokens.name: ink-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on taupe, rose and sage fills (reference: white text on the base card and buttons).

tokens.name: line

tokens.name: line-strong

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The focus ring color, light blue as in the reference (focus ring is always visible and glowing). Source-exact: 1.7:1 on canvas, below the 3:1 mark floor; the 3px halo plus the 14px glow make it visible. Marks only.

tokens.name: focus-glow
